result:
Round 334 is planned and dispatched. The decision is **CONTINUE**: nothing external blocks the next round.

**Round 333 closed on evidence.** C passed all 10 rows in a real browser with 0 bugs, and gate 333 published `3f945e3` to both remotes. That commit is the round-334 baseline. Stage c2b-ii is now done in the backlog (v293, decisions D-29z995…D-29z1003). Gate-review rulings:
- **Typed text lost on drag:** text typed into the Start field is replaced when the user drags the clip. That is current behaviour, so it went to `deferred_low_polish` as a question for Saba. Changing it needs his approval.
- **Doc 232 header:** its numbers and status line get fixed in round 334's doc edit, and the status line moves to the lessons.md L28 post-PASS form.
- **The other two suggestions:** no fix needed; recorded as info.
- **Architecture note ("keep"):** recorded as a backlog signal, not a task.

**Round 334 is PERF-DRAG-PREVIEW stage c2b-iii.** `ArrangementPeakPath` now takes four plain values (`clipId`, `sourceOffset`, `duration`, `gainDb`) instead of the whole clip object. Its memo had been failing on every drag move. Two small shared helpers back this: `waveformScaleForGainDb` and `gainDbLinearGain`.
- **Exact patch:** `b-round-333/sketch/sketch.patch.txt`, 6 files. A applies it and edits doc 232, 7 files in total, with listed STOP conditions.
- **Tests:** 8 new rows. DP43–DP48 count renders; WG9 and WG10 check the drawn shape when a clip has a source offset.

**What I measured on a scratch copy of `3f945e3`:**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Fade drag | 10.817 → 9.833 components per move |
| Same-lane move | 26.233 → 24.267 components per move |
| Other perf rows | trim, range, click and hook-live unchanged; 104 rows equal, 17 lower |
| Names probe | only the waveform component's renders disappear |
| Waveform drawing | equal to HEAD at 22 samples per viewport, at 1440×900 and 1280×720 |
| Tests | 155 covering files, 2459/2459 green; typecheck and Biome clean |
| Mutants | 9/9 red |

Two of the mutants (the detail panel's source offset, and stale memo dependencies) survived my first sketch. I added WG9 and WG10 until both turned red.

**Gaps:**
- **Trim-end:** my browser probe's trim-end drag never actually changed the clip, probably because its right edge is off-screen. C has its own trim-end sample, and jsdom covers that path.
- **Video:** the demo library has no video, so C's video row adds `public/videos/hero/1.mp4` the same way the existing rows script does.

**Order after 334:**
1. The 3-day regression round. It is due at the first planning on or after 2026-11-05 (the last one was 2026-11-02).
2. Stages c3–c5.
3. PERF-9…15, then the rest of the queue.
4. Next RETRO at round 336.

Checkpoint D-29z915 is still unanswered by root. Round 334 doesn't touch the files it covers, so it doesn't wait.
